messages:
Diego PR: Heads up — analyst from TechBrief asked for additional 95th pct latency numbers under embargo, wants a quick morning briefing (9:00 PT) tomorrow. Can we field this?
Ava Marketing: sharing — thanks. Is this a quote request or just data? Any named analyst? @Raj can you confirm metrics?
Raj Research: it's for the benchmark appendix. They want 95th (p99 too if available) across our hosted and dedicated configs. I have rough numbers but need another hour to validate. Not ready for external yet.
Sofia Product: if it's under embargo we should route quotes through Product/PR. What's the embargo cutoff? pressbot: Embargo window set by launch: 2026-04-01T16:00:00Z — internal only until then. /embargo details on console.
Diego PR: thanks @pressbot. @Maya legal — any restrictions on sharing the raw p95/p99 before embargo lifts? Could be sensitive vs. benchmark narrative.
Maya Legal: we can't share raw customer data. Aggregated p95/p99 across our test harness is fine. Need a one-line attribution approved: "Redwood Inference internal benchmark". Send factcheck to press@redwood.com.
Tia Ops: I can generate the validated p95/p99 from the staging harness now — ETA 45m. Will push CSV to the shared drive and tag for review.
Raj Research: great. I'll sanity-check the numbers and produce a short explainer of the test config (model, sequence length, batch policy). Example snippet:
```
config: tiny-bench
model: rdx-7b
seq: 1024
batching: dynamic, prefix-cache: on
```
Diego PR: ok — plan: Tia -> run, Raj -> validate, Ava -> pre-draft quote, Maya -> legal bless attribution, I’ll schedule 9:00 PT briefing and invite analyst. Who can join at 9?
Ava Marketing: I can take the briefing. @Sofia want to appear for product Qs?
Sofia Product: yes, I can. Keep it to 20m max.
Diego PR: perfect. @pressbot make a note: briefing invite sent to analyst; factcheck deliverable: CSV + short test config + one-line attribution. Send to press@redwood.com and cc me.
pressbot: Noted — briefing invite queued. Reminder will go 1h before. :bell:
Ava Marketing: I'll draft the one-line and pre-approve with Maya. Diego — do you want me to include a paragraph on the benchmark narrative for the reporter? We should keep it succinct.
Diego PR: yes, 2-3 sentences about workload alignment and serving choices. Avoid specific customer names. Use internal benchmark attribution per Maya.
Raj Research: I'll attach the FAQ on what p95/p99 means and how we measure it.
Tia Ops: data pushed to drive: /shared/launch/benchmarks/p95_1902500000.csv — tag: for-review
Maya Legal: received. Ping me when Ava has the draft. Quick check only.
Ava Marketing: draft done, shared to channel. Short feedback? :eyes: 
Diego PR: LGTM. I'll send the briefing invite now and confirm analyst details in DM.
Sofia Product: thanks team. Keep me posted if they ask for webinar follow-up — we can route to product demo.
Diego PR: will do. Closing thread — will post final factcheck link once Raj gives the OK.
